search.hint: Search for a card via Scryfall Syntax

syntax.title: Scryfall Syntax Guide
syntax.intro: Search works like Scryfall: combine keywords such as t:creature or c:r. All terms must match. Use OR and parentheses for alternatives.
syntax.tap_hint: Tap an example to run it in the search.

colors.title: Colors and color identity
colors.description: Use c: or color: for the colors of a card and id: or identity: for its color identity. Use the letters w, u, b, r, g, nicknames like azorius, bant, abzan or chaos, c for colorless, m for multicolor, or a number for the amount of colors. Comparisons (>, >=, <, <=, =, !=) check against ranges of colors. Full color names like 'blue' are not supported yet.
colors.ex1: Cards that are at least red and green
colors.ex3: Cards that fit into an Esper commander deck

types.title: Card types
types.description: Use t: or type: to search supertypes, card types and subtypes. Partial words are allowed. Put quotes around text with spaces.

text.title: Card text
text.description: Use o: or oracle: to find phrases in the rules text. Put quotes around phrases and use ~ as a placeholder for the card's name. Use kw: or keyword: for keyword abilities.

mana.title: Mana costs
mana.description: Use m: or mana: to search mana costs. Symbols that are not split can be written without braces (G is the same as {G}), split symbols like {2/G} always need braces. With comparisons, a cost is greater if it contains the same symbols and more. Use cmc: or mv: for the mana value and produces: for mana a card can produce.
mana.ex1: One green and one blue mana in the cost
mana.ex2: Two generic and two white mana in the cost
mana.ex3: Costs more than three generic, one white and one blue
mana.ex4: One Phyrexian red mana in the cost
mana.ex6: Cards that produce white and blue mana

pt.title: Power, toughness and loyalty
pt.description: Use pow:/power:, tou:/toughness: and loy:/loyalty: with comparisons. You can compare against a number or against each other (pow>tou). A * counts as 0.
pt.ex2: Creatures with more power than toughness

faces.title: Multi-faced cards
faces.description: Find cards with more than one face using the is: keyword: is:split, is:flip, is:transform, is:meld, is:leveler, is:dfc, is:mdfc, is:meldpart and is:meldresult.

spells.title: Spells, permanents and effects
spells.description: Cards that are cast as spells (is:spell), permanents (is:permanent), historic cards (is:historic), creatures for your party (is:party) or outlaws (is:outlaw), modal effects (is:modal), vanilla creatures (is:vanilla), French vanilla (is:frenchvanilla), 2/2 'bears' (is:bear) and lands that become creatures (is:manland).
spells.ex6: Cleric, Rogue, Warrior or Wizard creatures

extra.title: Extra and funny cards
extra.description: Tokens, emblems, planes, schemes, vanguards and cards from memorabilia, promo and funny sets are hidden by default. Search for their type with t: or for a set with s: to show them.

rarity.title: Rarity
rarity.description: Use r: or rarity: with common, uncommon, rare or mythic. Comparisons like >= work too.

sets.title: Sets and blocks
sets.description: Use s:, e:, set: or edition: with a set code, cn: or number: for the collector number (exact match only), b: or block: with the code of the block (the code of its first set), g: or group: for a set and everything directly tied to it, and st: or set_type: for the type of set.
sets.ex1: Cards from War of the Spark
sets.ex2: Cards from War of the Spark boosters
sets.ex3: Collector number 100 in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty
sets.ex5: Final Fantasy cards including related sets
sets.ex7: Legendary cards that are not in boosters

legality.title: Format legality
legality.description: Use f: or format: to find legal cards, banned: for banned and restricted: for restricted cards. Formats: standard, future, historic, timeless, gladiator, pioneer, modern, legacy, pauper, vintage, penny, commander (edh), oathbreaker, standardbrawl, brawl, alchemy, paupercommander, duel, oldschool, premodern and predh. Special is: keywords: commander, brawler, companion, duelcommander, oathbreaker, partner, gamechanger and reserved.
legality.ex4: Possible commanders in an Izzet deck
legality.ex6: Cards with any kind of Partner

prices.title: USD/EUR/TIX prices
prices.description: Use usd, eur or tix with comparisons to filter prints by price.
prices.ex2: Prints that cost 10 EUR or more

artist.title: Artist, flavor text and watermark
artist.description: Use a: or artist: for the artist, ft: or flavor: for flavor text and wm: or watermark: for the watermark. Put quotes around text with spaces.

frame.title: Border, frame, foil and resolution
frame.description: Use border: (black, white, silver, borderless), frame: (1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, future) and stamp: for the security stamp. is:full finds full art, is:foil, is:etched and is:glossy filter finishes and is:hires finds high-resolution images.
frame.ex3: Cards with an oval security stamp

year.title: Year
year.description: Use year with comparisons to find cards released relative to a certain year. now and today stand for the current year.

tags.title: Tagger tags
tags.description: Use art:, atag: or arttag: to find things in a card's illustration. Use function:, otag: or oracletag: to find Oracle tags that describe the function of a card. The data comes from the Tagger project.

reprints.title: Reprints
reprints.description: Find reprints with is:reprint and cards that were new in their set with not:reprint.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Cards are searched in English by default. Use lang: or language: to request another language, or lang:any for all languages. Only English and German cards are imported at the moment.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts and nicknames
shortcuts.description: Convenience shortcuts for land groups like is:bikeland, bondland, bounceland, canopyland, checkland, creatureland, dual, fastland, fetchland, filterland, gainland, painland, pathway, scryland, surveilland, shadowland, shockland, slowland, storageland, tangoland, tricycleland (triome) and triland, plus is:masterpiece.

logic.title: Negation, OR and parentheses
logic.description: All keywords can be negated with a hyphen: -t:creature. not: is the same as -is:. Words without a keyword search the card name, quotes keep phrases together. Terms are combined with AND by default, use OR between them for alternatives and parentheses to group.
logic.ex3: Goblins or Elves that are not green
logic.ex5: Cards with 'serra angel' in the name
